data.long_meaning: Arsika is a Sanskrit name derived from the root words 'ars' meaning 'arise' and 'ik' meaning 'cosmos'. This name signifies the one who arises from the cosmos or the universe itself. It is a name that carries deep spiritual significance and is often given to a child believed to be a divine gift. The name Arsika carries the meaning “Arising from the cosmos” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Arsika usually hope their child will grow to embody arising from the cosmos and live with faith, good character and purpose.
